glomeris execute — Run one action against one resource, under policy.

usage: glomeris execute --action-id <id> --resource-id <id>
                [--confirm-ask --observed-fingerprint <token>]
                [--project-root <path>]... [--json] [--progress-json]

Can delete data — every deletion is policy-gated.

The only command that performs one specific deletion you named. You supply
selectors and nothing else: there is no flag to pass a policy class, a raw
path as a target, a shell string, or a --force override.

What happens to the resource is policy's decision, not yours and not this flag
list's. AUTO_SAFE proceeds with no confirmation. ASK requires --confirm-ask
together with the exact --observed-fingerprint token from a prior `explain
--json` on that same resource — a fingerprint this process observed itself
would defeat the point, so it is not accepted. PROTECTED refuses
unconditionally: no combination of flags that exists can authorize it. Even
after authorization, a revalidation immediately before deletion aborts the
plan if the resource changed in between.

Options
  --action-id <id>
      Required. Must match the action the resolved resource actually
      offers, as printed by `actions list` or `explain`.
  --resource-id <id>
      Required. A resource id as printed by `detect` or `explain`.
  --confirm-ask
      Supply consent for an ASK-classified resource. Must be passed
      together with --observed-fingerprint or not at all.
  --observed-fingerprint <token>
      The fingerprint_token from a prior `explain --json` on this
      resource, copied verbatim. Never hand-constructed.
  --project-root <path>
      Same meaning as for `detect`. Repeatable.
  --json
      Print an ExecuteReport, or an ExecuteRefusalReport naming which
      refusal fired, on stdout. Never silent on a non-executed outcome.
  --progress-json
      Stream progress events as JSON lines to stderr.

Examples
  glomeris execute --action-id cargo.clean.target_dir \
    --resource-id cargo_target_dir:/Users/me/proj/target --json
      An AUTO_SAFE resource needs no confirmation flags.
  glomeris execute --action-id <id> --resource-id <id> \
    --confirm-ask --observed-fingerprint "$TOKEN"
      An ASK resource, with consent pinned to what `explain` saw.

Exit codes
  0   the action executed and succeeded.
  1   the action executed but a step of the plan failed.
  2   usage error, including --confirm-ask without a fingerprint or a
      malformed token.
  3   refused by policy: PROTECTED, ASK with no consent, or a consent that
      did not match.
  4   aborted by revalidation — the resource changed between
      authorization and deletion.
  5   the resource id matched nothing, offered no action, or offered a
      different one.
  75  another glomeris invocation holds the execution lock.
  Run `glomeris help exit-codes` for the codes shared by every command.

See also: explain, clean, actions
